prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in League City, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1056; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in at the location in League City, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: Sure. I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, so I'll just say I'm the driver of the vehicle that was struck head-on.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe what happened as best you can remember?

A: I was heading down the road in my own lane, going slowly because of the traffic ahead. The other car drifted over the center line and we ended up nose to nose. It wasn't a hard hit, but the airbags didn't deploy and both cars were still drivable for a moment.

Q: How fast do you believe you were traveling?

A: Maybe fifteen or twenty miles an hour. I was slowing down, so I doubt it was more than that.

Q: Did you receive medical attention after the collision?

A: Yes. An ambulance took me to the hospital. They X-rayed my arm and wrist and told me I had a fracture in my wrist. I'm wearing a splint now and I've got a follow-up appointment with a specialist.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limited movement?

A: Yes, especially when I grip anything or try to turn a doorknob. The doctor said it will take several weeks to heal properly, and I may need physical therapy.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'll send you the medical records once I get them.

Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
